title: Forgetting scalar sheaves and the canonical scalar Ext comparison
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. On the Zariski site $X_{\rm Zar}$ [def-sc-zariski-site], write $\operatorname{Sh}_k(X)$ for the category of sheaves of $k$-vector spaces, with constant-field tensor unit $\underline k$, as in [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Define $U:\operatorname{Sh}_k(X)\to\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\rm Zar},\operatorname{Ab})$ by forgetting the $k$-action sectionwise, on objects and morphisms. Define $e_{k,X}\in H^0(X,U\underline k)$ to be the degree-zero class corresponding to the global section $1$ of $\underline k$, obtained from the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction. Here abelian-sheaf cohomology is $H^n(X,A)=\operatorname{Ext}^n(\underline{\mathbb Z},A)$. For every $F\in\operatorname{Sh}_k(X)$, every $n\geq0$ and $x\in\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\operatorname{Sh}_k(X)}(\underline k,F)$, define the scalar-to-abelian comparison to send $x$ to $e_{k,X}\cdot U_*(x)\in H^n(X,UF)$, where $U_*$ is the Ext map of the exact forgetful functor and the product is Yoneda composition (first $e_{k,X}$, then $U_*(x)$).

noncomputable def scalarAbelianExtComparison (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : KSheaf X k) (n : ℕ) (x : Abelian.Ext.{u + 1} (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k)) F n) :
